lines.full: %s lies here, but your bag is full.
lines.hello: A trader has made a home of this cell. It has things, and it wants gold.
lines.sold_out: Nothing left to sell. The trader shrugs.
lines.bye: The trader goes back to counting.
lines.sharpened: You work the %s along your edge. Your next strike hits %d harder.
lines.escaped: You throw %s and walk out of the smoke. %s never saw which way you went.
lines.loved: It is exactly what it wanted.
